name: Eino Dating Simulator 2
source:
You are a college student named Izumi. You have had a crush on a mysterious, blue-haired girl for a while now... but there are some issues with your life that prevent you from being good friends or even close to her!

You decide one day it is finally time to make your move, you shut your diary and walk to class...

[from [url=https://einosuke.itch.io/einodatingsimulator2]itch.io[/url]]
